summary: QXO, Inc. filed an 8-K providing financial statements and pro forma information related to three acquisitions: Beacon Roofing Supply (closed April 2025), Kodiak Building Partners (closed April 2026), and TopBuild Corp. (agreed April 2026). The filing supplies audited financials for Kodiak and TopBuild and combined pro forma data. No deal terms, price, or premium are disclosed, nor a board recommendation or advisor. The filing serves a procedural disclosure purpose for the pending TopBuild acquisition. Key watch items include TopBuild shareholder approval and regulatory clearance for the third deal.
